questions.q: What is lost if a team configures Oracle Fusion directly from workshop notes, skipping a configuration workbook?
options: Nothing; the workbook is purely optional paperwork
The audit trail: why a setting was chosen, and a concrete item for business sign-off
The ability to run fit-gap analysis
The requirement's unique ID
questions.explain: Without a workbook, nobody can see why a setting was chosen, there's nothing concrete for business to sign off, and technical consultants lack a single source of truth.

questions.q: How is a configuration workbook typically organized?
options: By bank account number only
Randomly, in the order decisions were made
To mirror Oracle's own task lists in Setup and Maintenance, one row per setup object
By Service Request severity level
questions.explain: A workbook mirrors Oracle's task list structure, with one section per task list and one row per setup object.

questions.q: Who drafts the configuration workbook for a module, and who signs off each section?
options: The Functional Consultant drafts it; the Business Process Owner signs off
The Executive Sponsor drafts it; Oracle Support signs off
The Technical Consultant drafts it; the Testing Lead signs off
The Data Migration Lead drafts it; the OCM Lead signs off
questions.explain: The Functional Consultant drafts the workbook from fit-gap outcomes, and the relevant Business Process Owner reviews and signs off each section.

questions.q: What happens to a configuration workbook after it is signed off?
options: It is discarded since Setup and Maintenance doesn't need it
It is submitted as a Service Request to Oracle
It replaces the Requirements Traceability Matrix
It becomes the literal input used to key values into Setup and Maintenance
questions.explain: Once signed off, the workbook moves into the Configure phase and becomes the direct input for keying setup values into Setup and Maintenance.

questions.q: In Brightfield's workbook row for the wire transfer auto-match rule, who provides sign-off?
options: The Executive Sponsor
The Treasury Manager
Oracle Support
The Data Migration Lead
questions.explain: The Treasury Manager signs off on the tolerance values for the wire transfer auto-match rule before the functional consultant keys them in.
